title: Online Generalized Sparse Regression: How Does Overparametrization Help?
abstract: arXiv:2608.17466v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Regularized sparse regression has been extensively studied in the offline setting, but online formulation remains relatively under-explored. This gap stems from four key challenges: (i) the infeasibility of dynamically updating the regularization parameter in every online round, (ii) managing storage and memory complexity, (iii) enabling real-time computation via closed-form updates rather than solving full optimization problems at each round, and (iv) achieving optimal statistical guarantees under realistic assumptions. In this paper, we propose an online generalized-sparsity-constrained regression framework, focusing on online cardinality-constrained linear regression and low-rank matrix sensing. Unlike online regularized regression, our constrained formulation eliminates the need for dynamic parameter tuning. We introduce an efficient online hard-thresholding algorithm that performs closed-form updates and requires storing only summ

translated_title: 在线广义稀疏回归：过参数化如何提供帮助？
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17466v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：正则化稀疏回归在离线设置中已被广泛研究，但在线公式化仍相对未充分探索。这一差距源于四个关键挑战：（i）在每轮在线更新中动态调整正则化参数不可行，（ii）管理存储和内存复杂度，（iii）通过闭式更新实现实时计算，而不是在每轮解决完整优化问题，以及（iv）在现实假设下实现最优统计保证。在本文中，我们提出了一种在线广义稀疏约束回归框架，重点研究在线基数约束线性回归和低秩矩阵感知。与在线正则化回归不同，我们的约束公式消除了动态参数调整的需求。我们引入了一种高效的在线硬阈值算法，该算法执行闭式更新，且仅需存储求和统计量。
tldr: 本文提出了一种在线广义稀疏约束回归框架，通过闭式更新和硬阈值算法，解决了在线正则化回归中的动态参数调整问题，并在过参数化条件下实现了最优统计保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an online generalized sparse-constrained regression framework, using closed-form updates and hard-thresholding to eliminate dynamic parameter tuning, achieving optimal statistical guarantees under overparametrization.
